description: This file is a React component that serves as the main entry point for a chess application frontend. It imports React, CSS, a ChessGame component, and a custom hook useTheme, and renders the ChessGame component within a styled div, providing theme toggling functionality.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component function that initializes theme using useTheme hook and renders the ChessGame component with theme and toggleTheme props.
